exposure: factor VIII (FVIII) in the third trimester
cohort: 33 women with inherited bleeding disorders (62 pregnancies) managed through the Inherited Bleeding Disorders Clinic of Southeastern Ontario
finding: Increased age at delivery and vaginal delivery were associated with increased risk of immediate PPH, while low third trimester VWF:RCo was associated with increased immediate PPH despite treatment; tranexamic acid use postpartum was associated with less severe bleeding in the 6-week postpartum period.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery was associated with an increased risk of immediate PPH.
